claims.object_text: increased CSF SNAP-25 levels in AD compared with LBD and controls
claims.quote: CSF β-synuclein, α-synuclein, SNAP-25, neurogranin, and NfL levels did not differ between LBD (n = 101, age 67.2 ± 7.8 years, 27.7% females) and controls (age 64.8 ± 8.6 years, 39.3% females) and were increased in AD (AD-MCI: n = 30, AD-dem: n = 30, age 72.3 ± 6.0 years, 63.3% females) compared with both groups (p < 0.001 for all comparisons).

claims.object_text: higher CSF SNAP-25 concentrations in LBD/A+T+ than in LBD/A+T-
claims.quote: CSF β-synuclein (p = 0.0021), α-synuclein (p = 0.0099), and SNAP-25 concentrations (p = 0.013) were also higher in LBD/A+T+ than in LBD/A+T- cases, which had synaptic biomarker levels within the normal range.

claims.object_text: no difference in SNAP-25 levels between LBD/A+T+ and AD
claims.quote: Moreover, LBD/A+T+ and AD cases did not differ in any biomarker level.
